name: Oregano Chicken with Red Pepper Pesto Pasta

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp oregano
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the peppers are done, transfer to a blender and set aside to cool.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems. Transfer half the basil to the blender with the peppers. Using a clean cutting board, roll up remaining basil leaves and thinly slice into ribbons; set aside for garnish.
Peel garlic and add to the blender.
Add pinenuts, sun-dried tomatoes, oil, salt, and crushed red pepper to the blender. Blend on high, adding water 1 tbsp at a time, if necessary, to form a semi-smooth pesto.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup pine nuts
9 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta and return to the pot. Add pesto, stir to combine, and place over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with chicken. Garnish with reserved basil and enjoy!
